name: io.github.Damien829/aipaygen
title: AIPayGen
description: Read x402-priced pages with paid_fetch from credit you top up (USDC today); AI Terms; 100+ tools

tools.name: search_marketplace
tools.description: Search 22,000+ AI-agent resources: AIPayGen's paid tools, 12,000+ third-party APIs (with docs and auth info, many x402-payable), 2,800+ MCP servers, 3,900+ reusable skills, 950+ registered agents and 1,500+ agent services. Free.

query.description: What you need, e.g. 'weather forecast API' or 'summarize pdf'. Constraints in words are applied and said back in `understood`: 'under $0.01', 'paid with usdc on base', 'pay per call', 'mcp', 'skill'

kind.description: Limit to one kind of result

max_price_usd.description: Only x402 listings whose own 402 quote, as last checked, is at most this many USD per call

network.description: Only x402 listings that quote on this network: CAIP-2 (eip155:8453 is Base) or an x402 name such as base

seller.description: Only this seller's listings: the seller.id a result gives (one wallet on one host)

tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Describe what you need ("current weather in Tokyo", "OCR a receipt", "company data from a domain") and get the best working, cheapest options from 15,000+ APIs and MCP servers, ranked by real health checks, with exactly how to call each one. Free. You call the provider directly.

need.description: What you want to get done, in plain words. Constraints in words are applied and said back in `understood`: 'under $0.01', 'paid with usdc on base', 'pay per call'

pay_with_x402.description: Only options payable per call with x402

max_price_usd.description: Skip options whose price per call is higher: the price their own 402 quoted in our last check when we have it, else the published one

network.description: Only x402 options seen quoting on this network: CAIP-2 (eip155:8453 is Base) or an x402 name such as base

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Free. Submit your public A2A agent card URL (usually https://<your-domain>/.well-known/agent-card.json) and your agent is listed and searchable in the AIPayGen marketplace, so other agents can find you. Re-submit any time to refresh.

card_url.description: Public https URL of your agent card JSON

tools.name: run_skill
tools.description: Run any of 3,900+ ready-made AI skills from the AIPayGen marketplace on your input: research, code review, market analysis, writing, extraction, summarizing and more. Find skill ids with search_marketplace (kind: skill). Failed or refused runs are never charged. Costs $0.005 per call.

skill_id.description: Skill id from search results, e.g. "skill:3683" or "3683"

input.description: What the skill should work on (a topic, text, code, ...)

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Resolve DNS records for a domain (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA; A, AAAA, MX, NS and TXT by default), identify its DNS host and email provider from its NS and MX records, and say whether the name resolves at all. Costs $0.001 per call.

types.description: Record types to fetch. Defaults to A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT.

tools.name: text_utils
tools.description: Everyday text operations in one call: SHA-1/256/512 hashes, Base64 and URL encode/decode, slugs, UUIDs, JSON validation and pretty-printing, word/character/sentence counts with reading time, and readability scores (Flesch, grade level). Costs $0.001 per call.

tools.name: jwt_decode
tools.description: Decode a JSON Web Token's header and claims, with issued/expiry times in plain dates, seconds left, and warnings for expired, not-yet-valid or unsigned (alg none) tokens. Decoding only; the signature isn't verified. Costs $0.001 per call.

tools.name: data_convert
tools.description: Convert data between formats: JSON to CSV, YAML or XML, and CSV to JSON, YAML or XML (header row becomes keys, numbers and booleans typed). Handles quoted CSV fields and nested JSON. Costs $0.001 per call.

delimiter.description: CSV delimiter for input. Default ",". Use "\t" for TSV.

tools.name: date_calc
tools.description: Date math agents get wrong: days and business days between two dates (skipping weekends and a country's public holidays), add or subtract days or business days, and facts about a date (weekday, ISO week, quarter, day of year, leap year). Costs $0.001 per call.

country.description: Skip this country's public holidays in business-day math, e.g. "US".

tools.name: time_zone
tools.description: Current time in any time zones, or convert a local time from one zone to others, with UTC offsets and daylight-saving handled. Accepts IANA names (Europe/Berlin) or common abbreviations (PST, CET, IST, JST). Costs $0.001 per call.

time.description: Local time to convert, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM". Default: now.

from.description: Zone that "time" is in. Default UTC.

tools.name: country_info
tools.description: Facts about any of 250 countries and territories by name or ISO code: official name, capital, region, currencies, languages, calling codes, internet domain, neighbors, area, coordinates and flag. Costs $0.001 per call.

tools.name: math_calc
tools.description: Exact math agents shouldn't guess: evaluate an expression (+ - * / % ^, sqrt, log, sin, pi...), summary statistics for a list of numbers (mean, median, std dev, percentiles, mode), or convert units (length, mass, volume, area, speed, data, time, energy, temperature). Costs $0.001 per call.

tools.name: language_detect
tools.description: Detect the language of any text (100+ languages): ISO 639-1 code, English name and script, plus the model's self-reported confidence (not a calibrated probability). Costs $0.001 per call.

tools.name: favicon
tools.description: Find a website's icons and logo: favicon, Apple touch icon, web-app manifest icons and social preview image, with sizes, absolute URLs and the best one to use. Costs $0.001 per call.

url.description: Website URL or domain, e.g. stripe.com

tools.name: ens_lookup
tools.description: Resolve an ENS name (vitalik.eth) to its Ethereum address, or a 0x address to its primary ENS name, with the avatar URL when one is set. ENS on Ethereum mainnet, resolved via ensideas.com; a name or address with no ENS record answers not found. Costs $0.001 per call.

query.description: An ENS name like "vitalik.eth" or a 0x address.

tools.name: book_search
tools.description: Find books by title, author, subject or ISBN across 40M+ records in Open Library: authors, first published year, editions, page count, ISBNs, subjects, ratings and cover image. Costs $0.001 per call.

query.description: Title, author or keywords, e.g. "dune herbert". Use this or isbn.

tools.name: economic_data
tools.description: Official World Bank figures for any country and year range: GDP, growth, GDP per capita, population, inflation, unemployment, life expectancy, government debt, exports, internet use and CO2, or any World Bank indicator code. Costs $0.001 per call.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. "US", "DE", "BRA", or "WLD" for the world.

indicator.description: One of: gdp, gdp_growth, gdp_per_capita, population, inflation, unemployment, life_expectancy, debt_to_gdp, exports, internet_users, co2_per_capita; or a World Bank code like "NY.GDP.MKTP.CD".

years.description: Most recent N years with data. Default 10.

tools.name: weather_alerts
tools.description: Active US National Weather Service warnings, watches and advisories (tornado, flood, hurricane, heat, winter storm, fire weather...) for a state or a point: event, severity, area, start and end times and safety instructions. Costs $0.001 per call.

state.description: US state code, e.g. "TX". Use this or lat/lon.

tools.name: product_lookup
tools.description: Look up a packaged food or drink by barcode (EAN/UPC) or name in Open Food Facts (3M+ products): brand, ingredients, allergens, Nutri-Score, NOVA processing level and nutrition per 100 g. Costs $0.001 per call.

query.description: Product name, e.g. "nutella". Use this or barcode.

tools.name: currency_convert
tools.description: Convert money between 30+ currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF, CNY, INR, BRL, MXN...) at European Central Bank reference rates, for today or any date back to 1999. Costs $0.001 per call.

from.description: Currency code to convert from, e.g. "USD".

to.description: Currency codes to convert to, e.g. ["EUR","JPY"]. Default: all.

tools.name: public_holidays
tools.description: Public and bank holidays for 100+ countries for any year, with local names, regional holidays and the next upcoming one. Useful for scheduling, delivery dates and business-day math. Costs $0.001 per call.

tools.name: wikipedia
tools.description: Look up any person, place, company, concept or event on Wikipedia and get a clean summary, a short description, an image and the article link. Any language edition. Good for grounding answers in facts. Costs $0.001 per call.

query.description: What to look up, e.g. "Ada Lovelace" or "Model Context Protocol".

tools.name: hacker_news
tools.description: Search Hacker News stories and discussions about any product, company or technology: titles, links, points, comment counts and dates. Sort by relevance or newest. Good for tech sentiment and launch tracking. Costs $0.001 per call.

tools.name: package_info
tools.description: Latest version, description, license, repository, homepage, release date and weekly downloads for any npm, PyPI or Rust (crates.io) package. Good for picking dependencies and checking they're maintained. Costs $0.001 per call.

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.description: Who owns an IP address: the network name, organization, country, address range (CIDR), abuse contact and reverse-DNS hostname, from the regional internet registries (RDAP). IPv4 and IPv6. Costs $0.001 per call.

tools.name: redirect_check
tools.description: Follow a link through every redirect (bit.ly, t.co, tracking links, http-to-https) and show each hop and where it really ends up, with the final status code. Use it to unshorten links or check them before visiting. Costs $0.001 per call.

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Turn an address or place name into coordinates, or coordinates into a street address, anywhere in the world (OpenStreetMap). Returns the formatted address, city, region, postcode and country. Costs $0.001 per call.

query.description: Address or place, e.g. "1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington". Use this or lat/lon.

limit.description: Matches to return for a forward search. Default 1.

tools.name: earthquakes
tools.description: Recent earthquakes worldwide or near a location from the USGS: magnitude, place, time, depth, tsunami flag and alert level. Filter by minimum magnitude, days back and radius around a point. Costs $0.001 per call.

lat.description: Center latitude for a radius search.

lon.description: Center longitude for a radius search.

radius_km.description: Radius around lat/lon in km. Default 500 when lat/lon are given.

tools.name: crypto_price
tools.description: Live USD price, 24h change, market cap and volume for any cryptocurrency by ticker or name (BTC, ETH, SOL, PEPE... 15,000+ coins), plus the market-wide Fear & Greed index. Costs $0.001 per call.

tools.name: dex_token
tools.description: Live on-chain market data for any token on 80+ chains and DEXes (Uniswap, Raydium, PancakeSwap, Aerodrome...): price, liquidity, 24h volume, buys vs sells, market cap and pair age. Search by name/ticker or look up a contract address. Costs $0.001 per call.

query.description: Token name or ticker, e.g. "PEPE". Use this or address.

address.description: Token contract address (EVM 0x... or Solana mint).

chain.description: Chain to look on with an address, e.g. "base", "ethereum", "solana", "bsc". Default: all.

limit.description: Number of pairs. Default 5, most liquid first.

tools.name: wallet_balance
tools.description: Native coin and USDC balance of any wallet address on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain and Avalanche at once, plus any extra ERC-20 token you name. Read straight from the chains. Costs $0.001 per call.

chains.description: Chains to check. Default: all (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche).

token.description: Optional extra ERC-20 token contract to check (on the first chain listed).

tools.name: gas_price
tools.description: Current gas price on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain and Avalanche, in gwei, with the latest block number. Use it to pick the cheapest chain or time a transaction. Costs $0.001 per call.

chains.description: Chains. Default: all (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche).

tools.name: prediction_markets
tools.description: Live crowd-forecast odds from Polymarket: search any topic (elections, crypto prices, sports, AI, economy) or list the busiest markets. Returns each outcome's implied probability, 24h change, volume, liquidity and end date. Costs $0.001 per call.

query.description: Topic to search, e.g. "bitcoin 2026", "fed rate cut". Omit for the top markets by 24h volume.

tools.name: stock_quote
tools.description: Latest price, daily change, day range, 52-week range and volume for up to 10 stocks, ETFs, indices, futures or forex pairs (Yahoo symbols: AAPL, SPY, ^GSPC, BTC-USD, EURUSD=X), with optional price history for charts and backtests. Costs $0.001 per call.

history.description: Also return closing prices over this range (daily; weekly for 5y).

tools.name: defi_tvl
tools.description: Total value locked (TVL) in DeFi from DefiLlama: the top chains ranked by TVL, one chain's TVL and rank, or one protocol's TVL (aave, uniswap, lido, ...). Use it to compare ecosystems or size a protocol. Costs $0.001 per call.

top.description: With neither protocol nor chain: how many top chains to list (default 15).

tools.name: defi_yields
tools.description: Best DeFi yields from DefiLlama's 15,000+ pools: filter by chain, protocol, token and stablecoin-only, with APY (base + rewards), 30-day mean, TVL, impermanent-loss risk and a trend outlook. Use it to find where to park USDC or compare lending rates. Costs $0.001 per call.

tools.name: stablecoins
tools.description: Supply and peg health of every stablecoin (USDT, USDC, USDS, PYUSD...): circulating supply, 1d/7d/30d supply change, current price vs peg, mechanism and chain count, plus the total USD-pegged market. From DefiLlama. Costs $0.001 per call.

symbol.description: One stablecoin, e.g. "USDC". Default: the largest ones.

tools.name: news_search
tools.description: Search the latest news from 17 major outlets (BBC, NYT, Guardian, NPR, Al Jazeera, DW, France 24, CNBC, TechCrunch, The Verge, Ars Technica, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block...) plus Hacker News: headline, link to the publisher, outlet, topic and publish time. Refreshed every 5 minutes. Good for monitoring markets, crypto, tech, companies and world events. Costs $0.001 per call.

query.description: Keywords (all must match); quote exact phrases, e.g. "stablecoin" or "\"interest rates\"".

tools.name: qr_code
tools.description: Turn any text, URL, payment link, Wi-Fi login or contact card into a QR code. Returns an SVG (inline and as a data URI) plus the module matrix, with error-correction level L/M/Q/H, custom colors and quiet zone. Up to 2,000 bytes of data at levels L and M, 1,663 at Q, 1,273 at H. Costs $0.001 per call.

ecc.description: Error correction: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25% (max 1,663 bytes), H 30% (max 1,273 bytes; use H if you'll overlay a logo).

border.description: Quiet-zone modules around the code (default 4; scanners need at least 2).

include_matrix.description: Also return the matrix as rows of 0/1 strings.

tools.name: site_crawl
tools.description: Everything a crawler or SEO agent needs before visiting a site: robots.txt rules for your user agent (is this URL allowed? crawl delay?), the site's sitemaps with page URLs and last-modified dates (following one sitemap-index level), and the internal/external links on the page. Costs $0.002 per call.

url.description: Page or site URL, e.g. https://example.com/blog

user_agent.description: Crawler name to check rules for (default "*"), e.g. "GPTBot", "Googlebot".

max_urls.description: Sitemap URLs and links to list (default 100 each).

tools.name: ai_crawler_check
tools.description: Which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot, Bytespider and 20+ more) a website's robots.txt allows or blocks, and whether it already charges them with HTTP 402. Free. For site owners deciding whether to block, allow or charge AI crawlers per page (see https://aipaygen.com/pay-per-crawl).

tools.name: ai_terms
tools.description: Before your agent reads a web page: does the site allow it, for which use (search, answer, training, agent), and at what price? Reads the site's AI Terms file (/.well-known/ai-terms) and answers for one URL and one use. Free. AI Terms is a file a website publishes at /.well-known/ai-terms that says, for each use of its content by AI (search, answer, training, agent), whether that use is allowed, allowed for a price, or not allowed.

url.description: The page you want to read, e.g. https://example.com/blog/post

use.description: What you will do with it: search, answer, training or agent

tools.name: ai_visibility_check
tools.description: Can AI answer engines like ChatGPT search, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini read and cite a website? Checks what the site controls: robots.txt rules for their crawlers, whether the door lets them in, whether the content is in the HTML or needs JavaScript, title and description, structured data, llms.txt and sitemap. Free. Also known as an AEO or GEO check. It reports facts; it can't promise an AI will mention a site.

tools.name: verify_bot
tools.description: Is this request really GPTBot, Googlebot or PerplexityBot? Checks an IP address (and optionally the user agent it sent) against the IP lists OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Mistral, DuckDuckGo, Common Crawl, Google, Bing and Apple publish. Says whether the bot is verified, fake (claims a bot but comes from elsewhere), disguised (an AI crawler's address sending a browser user agent) or unverifiable (operator publishes no list), and whether pay-per-crawl would charge it. Also checks Web Bot Auth signatures (pass the signature headers): a valid one verifies the agent from any address. Free.

ip.description: The request's IP address, IPv4 or IPv6

signature.description: Web Bot Auth headers to check (RFC 9421 signatures): verified by the agent's published key from any address.

url.description: The https URL the request was sent to (its host is the signed @authority)

signature_agent.description: The Signature-Agent header, as sent (a quoted string, e.g. "https://chatgpt.com")

tools.name: market_listing
tools.description: One listing from the AIPayGen marketplace (an API, MCP server, skill, agent or service): name, description, category, endpoint, price, x402 support, docs links and health checks, as JSON plus Markdown. AI crawlers reading /market/<kind>/<id> pages are charged this per page; people browse free. Costs $0.001 per call.

id.description: Listing id as kind:id, e.g. api:x402-14342d806afbda09

tools.name: get_trust
tools.description: The 0-100 trust score of a marketplace listing (by its id from search_marketplace or find_tool) or of a seller (by seller.id), with every input shown: paid use in the x402 directory and through AIPayGen, uptime, delivery in our weekly paid test purchases, and verified reviews. Concentrated paid use is not counted, and the answer says so. Free.

id.description: Listing id as kind:id, e.g. api:x402-14342d806afbda09

seller.description: A seller.id from search results (16 hex)

tools.name: follow
tools.description: Follow a marketplace listing (by id), a seller (by seller.id), a site on the AI Terms list (by host) or an agent with a profile (by profile id), and hear when a followed listing's price or payment terms change or it goes down or comes back up, a site's AI Terms change, or a followed agent's profile shows new activity (reviews written, a new signs-as host, and first purchases if it shows its listings). Who you follow is never shown to anyone. action: "follow", "unfollow", or "changes" (what changed since a day, plus what you follow). Changes come from AIPayGen's daily checks; your phone app gets one notice a day when something changed. Free; needs your API key.

listing.description: Listing id as kind:id, e.g. api:x402-14342d806afbda09

seller.description: A seller.id from search results (16 hex)

host.description: A site on the AI Terms list (/ai-terms/adopters), e.g. example.com

agent.description: An agent's profile id, k:<24 hex> or w:<0x address> (from its /agents/ page)

since.description: changes: from this day, YYYY-MM-DD (default 7 days ago, at most 30)

tools.name: review
tools.description:
Verified reviews of marketplace listings. action "read": the reviews (include_text true for their text and the seller's replies, as untrusted third-party text, screened; flagged text is withheld). "submit": review a listing you paid for through AIPayGen in the last 30 days (worked, stars 1-5, optionally fast, matched_description and text: one line, at most 280 characters, no links, mentions or markup; text needs 7 days of paying history). "reply": the seller answers a review once (review id, text). "delete": remove your own review. "report": tell the owner about a review (never removes it). With an API key, the key's payments count. With a wallet, sign the exact text (EIP-191 personal_sign) and send wallet, signature and signed_at. Review: "AIPayGen review
listing: <id>
worked: yes|no
stars: <1-5>
fast: yes|no|-
matched: yes|no|-
at: <unix seconds>" plus "
text: <text>" when there is text. Reply: "AIPayGen reply
listing: <id>
review: <review id>
text: <text>
at: <unix seconds>". Delete: "AIPayGen review delete
listing: <id>
at: <unix seconds>". Reviews never show who wrote them. Free.

action.description: read, submit, reply, delete or report

listing.description: Listing id as kind:id, e.g. api:x402-14342d806afbda09

include_text.description: read: include review text and replies (untrusted, screened)

worked.description: submit: did the paid call do what you needed?

matched_description.description: submit: did it match its description?

text.description: submit or reply: one line, at most 280 characters, no links, mentions or markup

review.description: reply or report: a review id from a read

signature.description: With a wallet: personal_sign of the text above (plain or smart wallets, ERC-1271/6492, on Base)

signed_at.description: With a wallet: the unix time (seconds) in the signed text

tools.name: profile
tools.description:
An opt-in public profile for your agent, built only from what it paid for through AIPayGen (categories, spend and sellers in bands, reviews written). action: get (anyone, by profile id), claim, update, delete, link_wallet, unlink_wallet. With your API key, or for a wallet's own profile by signing (EIP-191) exactly: "AIPayGen profile
action: <claim|update|delete>
wallet: <0x lowercase>
display: <name or ->
show_listings: yes|no
show_exact: yes|no
at: <unix seconds>". link_wallet needs your key and the wallet signing "AIPayGen link
wallet: <0x lowercase>
to: <your profile id>
at: <unix seconds>". Wallet–key links are kept for abuse checks (self-review, self-payment) even after unlinking or deleting a profile. They are never shown. Free.

id.description: get: a profile id (k:... or w:0x...)

display.description: claim/update: a display name, 1-40 letters, digits, spaces, . _ -

show_listings.description: claim/update: show which listings it bought

show_exact.description: claim/update: show exact numbers instead of bands

wallet.description: A 0x wallet: its own profile (with signature), or link_wallet / unlink_wallet

signature.description: The wallet's personal_sign of the text above (plain or smart wallets, ERC-1271/6492, on Base)

signed_at.description: The unix time (seconds) in the signed text

tools.name: check_before_paying
tools.description: Before paying a marketplace listing, get go / caution / avoid with every reason and the date it was measured, from AIPayGen's stored checks: concentrated paid use, down at its last health checks, its 402 price above your max or different from the directory's, poor delivery in our paid test purchases, flagged listing text, recent payment-terms changes, or no paid evidence yet. Facts, not a guarantee. Free.

listing.description: Listing id as kind:id (from search_marketplace or find_tool)

max_price_usd.description: The most you'd pay per call, in USD

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the whole web and get ranked results: title, URL, snippet, site and publish date, plus top news when relevant. Filter by recency (day/week/month/year), country and language. Independent index (Brave Search). Pair with page_to_markdown to read a result. Costs $0.005 per call.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. "x402 payment protocol" or "site:github.com mcp server".

freshness.description: Only pages from the last day, week, month or year.

country.description: Two-letter country for local results, e.g. "US", "DE".

tools.name: paid_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a page or API response (GET, or POST JSON) from a site that charges AI agents with HTTP 402 (x402), paid from AIPayGen credit you bought with a top-up: no wallet needed. Trial and referral credit pay only this $0.001 fee and free pages. You set max_price_usd and pay the site's price plus 15%, plus the fee. A site that takes the payment but doesn't return the page can't be refunded, so buy from sites you trust; if it never collects, your credit returns once the payment expires. Costs $0.001 per call, from an API key's prepaid credit (not payable with x402).

url.description: https URL of the page or API to buy, e.g. https://example.com/article

max_price_usd.description: Most you'll pay the site for this page (default 0.05, at most 1). Our 15% fee is on top.

method.description: GET (default) or POST, for paid APIs that take input.

body.description: POST only: a JSON object or array (at most 16 KB), sent as application/json, byte for byte the same on the unpaid and the paid request.

tools.name: memory_set
tools.description: Persistent memory for AI agents that survives across sessions, keys and wallets: save, overwrite or delete a value (text or JSON, up to 16 KB) under a key, with an optional expiry. Up to 500 keys per memory. Read it back with memory_get. Costs $0.002 per call.

secret.description: Your private memory secret (16+ chars). The same secret always opens the same memory; share it to share memory between agents. Keep it secret: anyone with it can read and write.

value.description: Any JSON value or text. Omit (or use delete: true) to delete the key.

ttl_seconds.description: Expire after this many seconds (60 s to 1 year). Default: never.

tools.name: memory_get
tools.description: Recall what an agent saved with memory_set: get one key, list keys (optionally by prefix), or search keys and values for words. Returns values with their last-updated times. Costs $0.001 per call.

secret.description: Your private memory secret (16+ chars). The same secret always opens the same memory; share it to share memory between agents. Keep it secret: anyone with it can read and write.

prefix.description: List keys starting with this, e.g. "user:42:".

search.description: Find keys whose key or value contains this text (case-insensitive).

tools.name: watch_create
tools.description: Get told when something changes, for 30 days: a URL goes down or comes back (url_status), a page's text changes or a phrase appears or disappears (page_text), a domain nears expiry or becomes available (domain_expiry), or a coin crosses a USD price (crypto_price). Events go to your https webhook (signed with HMAC-SHA256) and are kept for watch_list. Unchanged checks are silent. Costs $0.01 per call.

secret.description: Your private secret (16+ chars), the same kind memory_set uses. It owns your watches: list and delete them with it.

target.description: url_status and page_text: an https URL. domain_expiry: a domain. crypto_price: a coin symbol or CoinGecko id, e.g. BTC.

above.description: crypto_price: alert when the price rises to this USD value.

below.description: crypto_price: alert when the price falls to this USD value.

contains.description: page_text: alert when this phrase appears or disappears, instead of on any change.

days.description: domain_expiry: alert this many days before expiry (default 30).

webhook.description: https URL we POST each event to, signed in the x-aipaygen-signature header.

tools.name: watch_list
tools.description: Your watches (made with watch_create), newest first, up to 25 per secret: for each, what it watches, what it last saw, its last 10 events (newest first), whether a webhook is set and when it expires. Pass id for just one. Free.

secret.description: Your private secret (16+ chars), the same kind memory_set uses. It owns your watches: list and delete them with it.

tools.name: watch_delete
tools.description: Stop and delete one of your watches, by the id from watch_create or watch_list, with the same secret it was made with. It is not checked again and sends no more events to its webhook. Watches also end on their own after 30 days. Free.

secret.description: Your private secret (16+ chars), the same kind memory_set uses. It owns your watches: list and delete them with it.

id.description: The watch id from watch_create or watch_list.

tools.name: wallet_report
tools.description: Everything to check before paying or trusting an EVM wallet, in one call: USDC and native balances on 7 chains, OFAC sanctions screening, and its ENS name. Takes an address or an ENS name, and returns a short verdict with warnings. Costs $0.003 per call.

wallet.description: A 0x address or an ENS name like "vitalik.eth".

tools.name: token_report
tools.description: Should an agent touch this token? One call combines the contract security scan (honeypot, taxes, mint, proxy, holder concentration) with live DEX price, liquidity and volume across pairs, and returns a verdict with the reasons. Costs $0.004 per call.

chain.description: Chain, e.g. base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum.

tools.name: notify
tools.description: Send a message to a human where they already are: a phone push notification (ntfy, free app, no account), a Discord or Slack channel, a Telegram chat, or any webhook. Use it to report a finished task, an error, or something that needs attention. Failed deliveries are not charged. Costs $0.001 per call.

channel.description: app (push to your owner's AIPayGen app; needs an API key), ntfy (phone push), discord, slack, telegram or webhook.

target.description: ntfy: a topic name only you know (e.g. "acme-agent-7f3a9c") or a full https URL to your ntfy server. discord / slack: the channel's incoming-webhook URL. telegram: "<bot token>|<chat id>". webhook: any https URL (we POST JSON).

title.description: Short title (bold or as the push title).

url.description: A link to open from the notification.

priority.description: ntfy priority (high makes the phone buzz). Default normal.

tools.name: ask_human
tools.description: Get a human's decision before you act: ask a question with up to 6 choices (default Approve / Deny). Returns a private link to send them; add `notify` and we push it to their phone, Discord, Slack or Telegram for you. Read the answer with ask_status (free) or get it on your webhook. Links expire after 24 hours by default. Costs $0.005 per call.

question.description: What to decide, e.g. "Pay $42 to Acme for the API plan?"

details.description: Context the human should see before choosing.

notify.description: Also send the link here (same channels as the notify tool).

channel.description: ntfy (phone push), discord, slack, telegram or webhook.

target.description: ntfy: a topic name only you know (e.g. "acme-agent-7f3a9c") or a full https URL to your ntfy server. discord / slack: the channel's incoming-webhook URL. telegram: "<bot token>|<chat id>". webhook: any https URL (we POST JSON).

webhook.description: https URL we POST the answer to when it arrives.

tools.name: ask_status
tools.description: The answer to an ask_human question: pending, answered (with the choice, an optional note and when) or expired. Free; poll it as often as once a minute.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Run any paid tool with the same input every hour, day or week, and get each result in the owner app, a webhook, ntfy, Discord, Slack or Telegram. Each run is billed at the tool's normal price to your API key's credits (and respects the key's daily limit); failed runs are free. Up to 10 per key. E.g. a morning news_search digest, an hourly crypto_price, a daily domain_report. Costs $0.001 per call, from an API key's prepaid credit (not payable with x402).

tool.description: The tool to run, e.g. news_search.

input.description: Its input, exactly as you would call it.

start_at.description: First run (ISO 8601 UTC), e.g. 2026-11-16T08:00:00Z. Default: in 5 minutes.

deliver.description: Where results go, e.g. {"channel":"app"} or {"channel":"ntfy","target":"my-topic"}. Default: the owner app.

tools.name: schedule_list
tools.description: Your API key's scheduled runs (made with schedule_create): for each, the tool and its input, how often it runs, whether it is paused, the next and last run, the last result status and how many times it has run. Free.

api_key.description: Your API key, if you can't send it as a Bearer header.

tools.name: schedule_delete
tools.description: Stop and delete one of your API key's scheduled runs, by the id from schedule_create or schedule_list (sch_ and 16 hex characters), sent with the same API key. It does not run or bill again; runs already made stay billed. Free.

tools.name: schedule_resume
tools.description: Restart one of your API key's paused scheduled runs (paused when the key ran out of credit, or after stopped runs), by the id from schedule_create or schedule_list, sent with the same API key. Add credit first: the key needs enough for one run. The next run is within about 10 minutes, then on its usual interval. Free.

tools.name: assistant
tools.description: Hand a task to AIPayGen's assistant in plain words: look things up (prices, news, weather, websites, wallets, tokens), set alerts (watches) and repeating routines that report to your phone, or message you. It picks and calls the right tools, paid from your key at their normal price (at most 4 tools and $0.05 per message). Free to ask.

message.description: What you want, e.g. "Every morning at 8 UTC send me x402 news, and alert me if ETH goes above 5000".

history.description: Earlier turns of this conversation, oldest first.

tools.name: my_account
tools.description: Your balance, today's spending, your agent keys and their daily limits, pending approvals, recent alerts, routines (schedules and watches) and 7-day spending by tool. Also returns links to the phone app and a calendar feed. Free; needs your API key.

tools.name: perp_funding
tools.description: Live perpetual-futures data from Hyperliquid for 200+ coins: funding rate (hourly and annualized), open interest, 24h volume and price change, mark vs oracle price and max leverage. Sort by funding, open interest or volume to spot crowded longs/shorts and basis-trade opportunities. Costs $0.001 per call.

coins.description: Coins, e.g. ["BTC","ETH","SOL"]. Default: the top markets.

limit.description: Markets to return when no coins are given (default 20).

tools.name: fear_greed
tools.description: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0 = extreme fear, 100 = extreme greed): today's value and classification plus up to 90 days of history with the average and change. A common market-sentiment input for trading agents. Costs $0.001 per call.

tools.name: sanctions_check
tools.description: Screen up to 20 crypto addresses (EVM, Bitcoin, Tron, Solana, Litecoin, Monero and more) against US OFAC sanctions: the Chainalysis on-chain sanctions oracle plus OFAC's SDN list of digital currency addresses. Use before accepting or sending funds. A screen, not legal advice. Costs $0.001 per call.

tools.name: tx_lookup
tools.description: Look up any transaction hash on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain or Avalanche (chain auto-detected): status, sender, recipient, value, fee, block time and decoded token transfers with symbols and amounts. Use it to confirm a payment landed. Costs $0.001 per call.

chain.description: Chain if known. Default: search all (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche).

tools.name: sentiment
tools.description: Fast positive / negative / neutral sentiment for up to 50 texts at once (reviews, tweets, support tickets, headlines), with a score from -1 (very negative) to +1 (very positive) and an average across all texts. Costs $0.001 per call.

texts.description: Texts to score, e.g. ["Love it!", "Shipping took forever."].

tools.name: embed_text
tools.description: Turn up to 100 texts into 1024-dimension embedding vectors (BGE-M3, 100+ languages) for semantic search, RAG, clustering, deduplication and recommendations. Costs $0.001 per call.

texts.description: Texts to embed, e.g. ["refund policy", "how do I get my money back?"].

tools.name: security_headers
tools.description: Grade a website's HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and more) A-F, list what is missing, and flag exposed server version info. Costs $0.001 per call.

url.description: Website URL or domain, e.g. https://example.com

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Current weather, the next 12 hours and a 5-day forecast for any place on Earth: temperature (C and F), conditions, rain, wind, humidity. Pass a place name ("Austin, TX") or lat/lon. Costs $0.002 per call.

location.description: Place name, e.g. "Paris, France" or "10001 USA". Use this or lat/lon.

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translate text between any two languages (100+). The source language is detected automatically. Keeps formatting, names, numbers and URLs intact. Up to 4,000 characters per call. Costs $0.001 per call.

text.description: The text to translate (up to 4,000 characters).

target_lang.description: Language to translate into, as a name or code: "Spanish", "es", "Japanese", "pt-BR".

source_lang.description: Source language, if known. Detected automatically when left out.

tools.name: classify_text
tools.description: Sort text into your own labels (support ticket routing, intent, topic, spam, lead quality) or, with no labels, get its sentiment (positive, negative, neutral). Returns the best label, a confidence and a one-line reason. Costs $0.002 per call.

labels.description: Your labels, e.g. ["billing", "bug", "feature request", "other"]. Default: sentiment.

multi.description: Allow more than one label. Default false.

tools.name: package_vulns
tools.description: Check an open-source package version for known security vulnerabilities (CVEs, GitHub advisories) across npm, PyPI, Go, Rust, Maven, RubyGems, NuGet, PHP and more. Returns each issue's severity and the version that fixes it. Costs $0.002 per call.

version.description: Version to check, e.g. "4.17.15". Leave out to list every known advisory.

tools.name: paper_search
tools.description: Search 2.4M+ research papers on arXiv (AI, machine learning, physics, math, CS, economics, biology): titles, authors, abstracts, dates and PDF links. Sort by relevance or newest. Costs $0.002 per call.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "retrieval augmented generation".

tools.name: domain_available
tools.description: Check whether a domain name is free to register across many extensions at once (.com, .net, .org, .io, .ai, .app, .dev, .xyz and 1,000+ more) using the registries' own RDAP data. Shows registrar and expiry for taken names. Costs $0.002 per call.

name.description: The name to check, with or without an extension: "aipaygen" or "aipaygen.com".

tlds.description: Extensions to try. Default: com, net, org, io, ai, co, app, dev, xyz.

tools.name: email_verify
tools.description: Check if an email address can receive mail before you send: syntax, whether the domain has mail servers (MX), disposable/throwaway providers (100k+ domains), role addresses like info@ or support@, free-provider detection and typo suggestions (gmial.com -> gmail.com). Returns a deliverable / risky / undeliverable verdict. Costs $0.002 per call.

tools.name: scholar_search
tools.description: Search 160M+ journal articles, conference papers, books and preprints across every field via Crossref: title, authors, journal, year, DOI, citation count and abstract. Or look up one DOI. Complements arXiv paper_search. Costs $0.002 per call.

query.description: Topic, title or author, e.g. "CRISPR off-target effects". Use this or doi.

doi.description: A DOI to look up, e.g. "10.1038/nature14539".

tools.name: regulations_search
tools.description: Search the US Federal Register: final rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents from every federal agency since 1994, with agency, dates, comment deadlines and links. Good for compliance, policy and legal research. Costs $0.002 per call.

limit.description: Number of documents. Default 10, newest first.

tools.name: drug_info
tools.description: Look up a US medicine by brand or generic name in FDA data: what it's for, active ingredients, dosage, warnings, when to ask a doctor, manufacturer, plus recent FDA recalls. Information only, not medical advice. Costs $0.002 per call.

name.description: Brand or generic name, e.g. "Advil" or "metformin".

tools.name: clinical_trials
tools.description: Search 500k+ clinical studies worldwide on ClinicalTrials.gov by condition, drug or keyword: status (recruiting, completed...), phase, sponsor, enrollment, start date, countries and the study link. Costs $0.002 per call.

query.description: Condition, drug or keyword, e.g. "GLP-1 obesity".

tools.name: rank_texts
tools.description: Score and sort up to 50 passages, documents or search results by how well they answer a query (BGE reranker). Drop-in quality boost for RAG and search pipelines. Costs $0.002 per call.

top_k.description: Return only the best N. Default: all.

tools.name: prompt_injection_check
tools.description: Screen untrusted text (web pages, emails, tool outputs, user messages) for prompt injection and jailbreak attempts before your agent reads it: rule-based signals (instruction overrides, secret or fund exfiltration, fake role tags, hidden unicode) plus an LLM judge. Returns a verdict, risk score and reasons. Costs $0.002 per call.

source.description: Where the text came from (helps the judge).

tools.name: token_security
tools.description: Check an ERC-20 token contract for scams before buying: honeypot, buy/sell taxes, mint and blacklist powers, hidden owner, proxy upgrades, unverified code, holder concentration. Returns a risk score and plain-English red flags. Ethereum, Base, BNB, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism, Avalanche. Costs $0.003 per call.

chain.description: Chain: ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche.

tools.name: domain_whois
tools.description: Look up who registered a domain and when: registrar, creation and expiry dates, domain age, status codes, nameservers and DNSSEC, via RDAP (the modern WHOIS). A subdomain is looked up as its registered domain (mail.google.com -> google.com). Extensions with no RDAP service return registered: null (unknown). Costs $0.002 per call.

tools.name: email_security
tools.description: Audit a domain's email security: SPF, DMARC policy, DKIM keys, MX/email provider, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI, with an A-F grade, a spoofability verdict and plain-English issues. Costs $0.002 per call.

tools.name: site_metadata
tools.description: Extract a website's title, description, language, social profiles, public contact emails and phones, key pages (contact, pricing, careers, docs), RSS feeds and schema.org organization data. Costs $0.002 per call.

url.description: Website URL or domain, e.g. notion.so

tools.name: page_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a web page and return its main content as clean Markdown (navigation, ads, scripts and cookie banners removed), ready for an LLM to read, with its title, word count and whether it was cut short: 20,000 characters by default, up to 100,000. Costs $0.002 per call.

tools.name: ssl_certificates
tools.description: Check a domain's TLS certificates from Certificate Transparency logs: current certificate, issuer, days until expiry, and the subdomains named on its unexpired certificates (expired ones are left out; very large domains are sampled, up to 2,000 certificates, and up to 500 subdomains are listed with the total count). Costs $0.003 per call.

tools.name: tech_stack
tools.description: Detect what a website is built with: framework, CMS or site builder, hosting/CDN, web server, analytics, ad pixels, payments, chat, auth and more (90+ technologies), with the evidence for each. Costs $0.003 per call.

url.description: Website URL or domain, e.g. linear.app

tools.name: summarize
tools.description: Summarize any text or web page into a TL;DR, bullet points or a short paragraph, with the key takeaways. Pass the text itself or just a URL. Works on articles, docs, transcripts, emails and reports. Costs $0.003 per call.

text.description: Text to process (first 12,000 characters are used). Use this or url.

url.description: A public web page to read instead of text, e.g. a news article or blog post.

max_words.description: Rough length limit for the summary. Default 120.

language.description: Write the summary in this language. Default: the source's language.

tools.name: extract_data
tools.description: Turn messy text or a web page into clean JSON: name the fields you want ("company", "price: in USD", "emails") and get them back as a JSON object, with null for anything not found. Great for scraping, lead capture, invoices, job posts and forms. Costs $0.004 per call.

text.description: Text to process (first 12,000 characters are used). Use this or url.

url.description: A public web page to read instead of text, e.g. a news article or blog post.

fields.description: Fields to extract, optionally with a hint after a colon: ["company", "price: monthly price in USD", "emails: all email addresses"].

tools.name: document_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert a PDF, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx/.xls), OpenDocument, CSV, HTML or XML file at a URL into clean Markdown text an LLM can read. Up to 10 MB. Great for invoices, reports, papers, contracts and spreadsheets. Costs $0.004 per call.

tools.name: describe_image
tools.description: Look at an image URL and describe it, read all text in it (OCR), or answer a question about it: screenshots, receipts, charts, documents, product photos, memes. JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 8 MB. Costs $0.006 per call.

question.description: What you want to know, e.g. "What is the total on this receipt?" Default: describe it and transcribe any text.

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Turn text into natural-sounding speech (WAV or MP3 audio) in English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese or Korean. Returns the audio as a base64 data URL. Good for voice replies, narration and accessibility. Costs $0.006 per call.

tools.name: ask_llm
tools.description: Send a prompt to an open-weight LLM (Llama 3.3 70B, or Llama 3.1 8B for speed) and get the answer. Pay per call with no account or API key: drafting, rewriting, reasoning, code help, brainstorming. Costs $0.004 per call.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe speech from an audio file URL (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, webm; up to 20 MB) into text with timestamps, in 90+ languages with automatic language detection. Can also translate the speech into English. Good for podcasts, calls, voice notes and meetings. Costs $0.01 per call.

url.description: Public URL of the audio file.

language.description: Spoken language code if known, e.g. "en", "es". Detected automatically otherwise.

translate_to_english.description: Translate the speech into English instead of transcribing it as spoken.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Create an original image from a text prompt with FLUX.1 [schnell]: illustrations, product shots, logos, thumbnails, concept art. Returns a 1024x1024 JPEG as a base64 data URL ready to save or display. Costs $0.01 per call.

prompt.description: What to draw, e.g. "a watercolor fox reading a newspaper in a cafe".

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: Build a company profile from just a domain: name, description, logo, location, social profiles, public contact info, domain age, email and hosting providers, key tech stack, and business signals (takes payments, hiring, runs ads...). One call instead of six. Costs $0.01 per call.

tools.name: domain_report
tools.description: Everything about a domain in one call: DNS, registration, certificates and subdomains, email security grade, HTTP security headers grade, tech stack and website metadata, plus an overall summary. Costs $0.02 per call.

tools.name: github_trending
tools.description: The fastest-rising new GitHub repositories: created in the last N days, ranked by stars, optionally filtered by language or topic. Names, descriptions, stars, forks, license and links. Good for spotting new tools and libraries early. Costs $0.001 per call.

days.description: Look at repositories created in the last N days. Default 7.

tools.name: fx_history
tools.description: Daily exchange rate history between currencies over a date range (European Central Bank reference rates, back to 1999), with the change over the period, high and low. For charts, backtests, invoices and trend questions. Costs $0.001 per call.

base.description: Currency code to convert from, e.g. "USD".

tools.name: sec_filings
tools.description: US public company data from SEC EDGAR by ticker or name: legal name, CIK, industry, state, recent filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K...) with links, and latest annual revenue, net income and total assets from XBRL. Official data, not stock prices. Costs $0.002 per call.

company.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. "AAPL" or "Nvidia".

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: List every tool with its price per call and the accepted payment methods. Free.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create a free AIPayGen API key: one free key per person, with $0.05 of trial credit for tools (not for paying sites). Store the key: it is shown only once.

label.description: Optional name for the key, e.g. your agent's name

ref.description: Referral code from the agent that told you about AIPayGen (it earns them credits). Picked up automatically from a ?ref= MCP URL.

tools.name: account_balance
tools.description: Show the remaining credit balance of the API key sent with this request. Free.
